usedFor: Each successful Stripe payment is recorded in QuickBooks.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Create Payment” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: A successful payment is money in, and “Create Payment” keeps QuickBooks matching your Stripe balance.

watchOut: “Invoice Is Finalized” and “When a checkout session is completed” also run “Create Payment”, so pick one trigger.
